name: Closed-form perspective-correct surfel rasterization
definition: A rasterization technique for planar surfels that computes screen-space texture coordinates (u, v) using an algebraically exact rational function of pixel position, avoiding per-pixel cross products and vector constructions.
summary: Closed-form perspective-correct surfel rasterization computes screen-space texture coordinates using an algebraically exact rational function, replacing per-pixel cross products with precomputed coefficients to reduce computational cost while maintaining visual fidelity.
